title: Unusual Spanish Cheese Paella
description: A sour and savory Spanish dish featuring Vasterbottensost cheese, perfect for a unique date night, this paella is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and has a glassy-jelly texture from the cheese and the kneading process.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Knead the Vasterbottensost cheese until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the pimenton and saffron threads to the oil and cook for 1 minute.
Add the uncooked calasparra rice to the pan and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the water, lemon juice, and salt to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the kneaded Vasterbottensost cheese and cook until melted and glassy.
Top the paella with dates and parsley.
Transfer the paella to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes.
